name: WV-02
label: Safe R

key_factors: Incumbent Riley Moore's large financial advantage
No polls or expert ratings to signal a competitive race
model.rationale: WV-02's R+20 lean and incumbent Riley Moore's roughly ten-to-one fundraising edge over Ace Parsi leave Democrats with no visible path. Prediction markets price Moore at about 97%, consistent with a Safe R rating built on fundamentals alone.
model.watch: Any credible polling showing Moore under 60% or a late surge of outside spending against him would be the first sign of a real contest.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
West Virginia's second district is one of the most Republican-leaning seats in the country, with a partisan lean of about R+20, and first-term incumbent Riley Moore is seeking reelection. He has raised over $1.3 million and holds more than $750,000 on hand, while Democratic challenger Ace Parsi has raised about $134,000 with limited cash remaining. No outside groups are active against Moore.

No public general-election polls or expert ratings are available for this race, so the outlook rests on fundamentals. Prediction markets give Moore roughly a 97% chance of winning, and the district's baseline margin points to a comfortable Republican victory in the high teens. Parsi would need a dramatic shift in the political environment to make this competitive.
